scope: Local behavioral tests plus read-only Shopify audit; no live mutations in this audit

matrix.proposed: Keep preparation separate from physical carrier pickup; CONFIRMED only when a fulfillment is intentionally created
IN_TRANSIT; inspect raw code because local IN_TRANSIT also includes on-hold
OUT_FOR_DELIVERY for SEND; return/exchange directions require separate handling
ATTEMPTED_DELIVERY for a real attempted delivery; retain raw code/reason to distinguish delay, loss and damage
DELAYED where appropriate; local normalization currently merges these with other states
Review FAILURE event semantics and preserve the raw carrier reason; never infer refund or order cancellation
DELIVERED with the actual carrier timestamp; shipping state must not automatically mark payment collected
Separate return workflow or explicit operational metadata; no RETURNED FulfillmentEventStatus exists
Separate shipment cancellation from order cancellation and refunds; no CANCELLED FulfillmentEventStatus exists
Review shipment identity/removal; do not cancel the order automatically
Record error or preserve known state; never fabricate a shipping event

findings.finding: No automatic Shopify shipping-event sender is invoked by applyDeliveryUpdate. Successful local-handler tests do not prove outbound synchronization.
Current order fulfillment is attempted at Bosta shipment registration; physical pickup is a separate event.
FAILED_ATTEMPT includes exception, lost, damaged, investigation and awaiting-action. A direct mapping would misrepresent some states.
On-hold (105) is normalized to IN_TRANSIT; outbound classification needs the raw carrier status and reason.
Current delivery timestamp defaults to processing time, and known backward transitions are applied. Outbound synchronization needs original timestamps and an explicit stale-event policy.
No durable shipping-event retry/idempotency queue is present in the current outbound path. Ad-hoc scripts for 2881/2882 are not production synchronization.
Payment synchronization is attached to manual COD confirmation, not all deposit or carrier-wallet flows. Do not infer payment from delivery.
